item.description: Astronomers have discovered the first confirmed dual active galactic nucleus in a Green Pea galaxy, revealing two supermassive black holes growing at the same time inside a compact, intensely star-forming system. The paper outlining the research was submitted to the arXiv preprint server on July 20. Fuente: Phys.org.
